title: Real Estate - Worldwide
highlights: The Real Estate market market worldwide is expected to reach a staggering value of US$624.62tn by 2026.
Among the various segments, Residential Real Estate dominates the market with a projected market volume of US$506.73tn in the same year.
Looking ahead, the sector is anticipated to grow at an annual rate of 3.03% (CAGR 2026-2031), resulting in a market volume of US$725.05tn by 2031.
In a global context, it is worth noting that China is set to generate the highest value in the Real Estate market market, with an impressive US$133.2tn projected for 2026.
In the United States, the real estate market is experiencing a surge in demand for suburban properties due to the increasing number of people working remotely.
